title: repo-viz review digest bundle
description: Read-only review-facing report of canonical SHA-256 digests for graph, indicator and audit artifacts. Digests cover canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact separators, UTF-8) of each source artifact with its own top-level digest field and only the declared volatile fields omitted.

config_digest.description: Canonical digest of parsed indicator config TOML, or null when no config was supplied.

config_path.description: Path of the config artifact used for config_digest.

source_commit.description: Source commit recorded by the paired graph artifact.

trigger.description: Effective trigger: the supplied --trigger, the single value found in indicator rows, or null when rows mix triggers.

audit.description: Absent when no audit artifact was supplied.

path.description: Artifact path used to compute the digest.

source_commit.description: Commit recorded by the artifact; indicator results inherit the paired graph's commit.

excluded_fields.description: Volatile fields omitted from the digest, expressed as artifact-relative paths.

schema.description: Value of the artifact's schema field, when present.

version.description: Value of the artifact's version field, when present (indicator results).

trigger.description: Effective trigger for this artifact, when applicable.
